parsed.title: Inconsistent route key
parsed.detail: The route `plan-feature:issue` is defined in the `routes` object, but the unit description and the `plan-feature:scaffold` entry suggest the intended key for the issue-based scaffold is `plan-feature:scaffold` or a similar mapping. More critically, the `plan-feature:scaffold` route exists but the `plan-feature:issue` route uses a different naming convention than the `plan-fix:issue` route, creating potential routing ambiguity in the deterministic router.
